description: Every Python file under src/ must carry a fixed copyright line as its first line, enforced by scripts/check.sh inside make test.

trap.reproduce: printf 'def f():\n    return 1\n' > src/textkit/extra.py && bash scripts/check.sh
trap.note: New files under src/ (including empty __init__.py files) must start with the exact Orbit Works copyright line; make test runs scripts/check.sh first and rejects files without it.

prompts.text: Add a function `slugify(text)` in a new module src/textkit/slug.py. It lowercases the text, replaces every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strips hyphens from both ends. Run the project's tests when you are done.

checks.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "from textkit.slug import slugify; print(slugify('  Hello, World!! 2026 '))"

prompts.text: Add a function `count_words(text)` in a new module src/textkit/wordcount.py. It returns a dict mapping each lowercased whitespace-separated word to how many times it occurs. Run the project's tests when you are done.

checks.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "from textkit.wordcount import count_words; print(sorted(count_words('a B b').items()))"

prompts.text: Add a function `rot13(text)` in a new module src/textkit/rot.py that applies the ROT13 substitution to letters and leaves everything else unchanged. Run the project's tests when you are done.

checks.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "from textkit.rot import rot13; print(rot13('Hello, World'))"
